messages.text: I have a small thinning patch

For a thinning patch, crown density is the right fit. It's SGD 1,100 per session, and most clients need 2 to 3 sessions for a natural-looking result.

On pain, most describe it as mild discomfort, like a light scratching sensation. We apply numbing cream beforehand so it's very manageable.

Would you like to book a consultation so we can assess the patch and give you an exact quote?
I have oily skin is it suitable?

Good question to ask. Oily skin can affect how the pigment settles, but it's absolutely treatable. We'd assess your skin type during the initial consultation and adjust the technique to make sure the result holds well over time.

Want me to book you in for a consultation so our specialist can take a proper look at the patch?

I understand it feels that way upfront. But consider this: it's a semi-permanent solution, so once it's done, you're not paying monthly for products or treatments that only partially work.

For a small thinning patch, you're looking at 2 to 3 crown density sessions at SGD 1,100 each. That's a one-time investment for a result that lasts years with minimal upkeep.

Want to start with a consultation first? No commitment, just a proper look at the patch so we can give you an exact plan.
Are there any discounts? You are more expensives than others

Pricing is set by our specialist team, so I can't offer discounts here. But honestly, the best way to know if it's worth it for you is to come in for a consultation, no commitment, they'll assess your patch and give you a clear picture of how many sessions you'd need and exactly what to expect.

Want me to lock in a time for you?
